title: These Haunted Minnesota Places Have Seriously Creepy Stories
excerpt: You’ve probably driven past some of these places and had no idea about the creepy things that happened there.
content:
Ever find yourself driving down a creepy road or past an old building and getting that instant, unexplainable chill? Apparently, Minnesota has way more supernatural hot spots than most realize. And every single one comes with a pretty wild history... plus plenty of reported ghost sightings that will make your skin crawl.

Spooky season doesn't even need to be here to give you goosebumps, but let's be real, this time of year, these stories hit a little different.

We all know that exact moment when a room suddenly feels totally off. A shadow moves where it shouldn’t, the lights flicker for no reason, or you swear you hear footsteps coming down a completely empty hallway.

I'm not talking about scary movies or staged-haunt experiences, we’re talking real-life haunted places right here in Minnesota, with ghost stories that are definitely enough to keep you up at night.

Also See: Step Inside Minnesota's Lost and Forgotten Ghost Towns

A few of these are famous local haunts that people travel across the state just to check out. But others? Others are everyday places you’ve probably driven past without realizing something creepy had happened there.

If you’re brave enough, check out these real haunted locations across Minnesota, where history and hauntings go hand in hand, and that next unexplained sound? It might not be the wind.

20 Of The Most Haunted Places in Minnesota

Minnesota’s got no shortage of ghost stories, and apparently, no shortage of ghosts either. Let's take a peek at some of the state’s most haunted places, according to MinnesotaHauntedHouses.com.

Gallery Credit: Samm Adams

Whether you believe in ghosts or not, these places make you think twice before turning off the lights. Ever had something happen that you can’t explain at any of these haunted spots? We’d love to hear it.
